issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings with private visibility ("-numberOfLoopings: int"). In the solution implementation RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings is declared protected. This changes the intended encapsulation and contradicts the UML/instruction to create attributes as shown. Students comparing the solution to the UML may be confused about the expected visibility and about encapsulation requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the numberOfLoopings attribute private in the solution (and template) to match the UML (change 'protected int numberOfLoopings;' to 'private int numberOfLoopings;'). Keep the public getter getNumberOfLoopings() for access. If subclasses need access, use the getter instead of widening the field's visibility.
